faq.q: How much does Patterson Law Group charge?
faq.a: Patterson Law Group publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Patterson Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Patterson Law Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Patterson Law Group have offices?
faq.a: Patterson Law Group publishes three offices, in Fort Worth, Arlington and San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Patterson Law Group?
faq.a: Patterson Law Group names ten attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Patterson Law Group?
faq.a: Patterson Law Group scores 54 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
